nodes.name: profile.py
nodes.summary: Defines authenticated profile GET, idempotent PUT and revision-checked PATCH routes. It validates bearer identities through the configured Supabase Auth user endpoint and applies user-scoped SQL transactions.

nodes.name: identity
nodes.summary: Validates a bearer token with the configured Supabase Auth endpoint and returns its verified UUID, using generic 401/503 failures.

nodes.name: db
nodes.summary: Returns the application database or reports its unavailability.

nodes.name: get_profile
nodes.summary: Reads only the authenticated user's profile under transaction-local RLS and returns 404 if absent.

nodes.name: create_profile
nodes.summary: Creates the authenticated profile without accepting a client user ID; repeats identical creation safely and rejects conflicting existing content.

nodes.name: update_profile
nodes.summary: Updates the owned profile only when its revision matches, incrementing the revision or returning a conflict.

nodes.name: ProfileInput
nodes.summary: Validates a bounded nonblank display name and one optional supported language while forbidding extra input fields.

nodes.name: ProfilePatch
nodes.summary: Extends profile input with the required positive revision for optimistic concurrency.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Loads typed backend settings from process variables and backend/.env, including the restricted SQL connection, pool limits, CORS origins and Supabase Auth endpoint.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.summary: Loads validated runtime settings, redacts the database secret in representations and bounds pool size and acquisition timeout.

nodes.name: database.py
nodes.summary: Manages a bounded synchronous Psycopg pool, checks the runtime role and schema marker, and provides transaction-local user identity for RLS.

nodes.name: Database
nodes.summary: Owns the synchronous connection pool and rejects privileged runtime connections before health checks or user transactions.

nodes.name: main.py
nodes.summary: Builds FastAPI with profile routes, explicit CORS, pool lifespan management and separate liveness/readiness probes.

nodes.name: create_app
nodes.summary: Creates the FastAPI application with injected settings/database factory, profile router, CORS and pool lifecycle.

nodes.name: conftest.py
nodes.summary: Provides dedicated local Supabase fixtures, restricted runtime database access and synthetic Auth students with cleanup.

nodes.name: stack
nodes.summary: Resolves the dedicated local Supabase stack for integration fixtures.

nodes.name: admin
nodes.summary: Opens the local administrator connection only after checking the project marker.

nodes.name: database
nodes.summary: Creates a one-connection runtime pool so tests can verify identity context reset across reused connections.

nodes.name: students
nodes.summary: Creates two synthetic Auth users and profiles and removes their identities after integration tests.

nodes.name: test_database.py
nodes.summary: Exercises real role restrictions, RLS account isolation, context cleanup, diagnostic foreign keys, immutable content and deletion cascades.

nodes.name: test_ready_with_actual_runtime_connection
nodes.summary: Verifies ready with actual runtime connection against the corresponding backend behavior.

nodes.name: test_privileged_connection_is_not_ready
nodes.summary: Verifies privileged connection is not ready against the corresponding backend behavior.

nodes.name: test_schema_version_mismatch_is_not_ready
nodes.summary: Verifies schema version mismatch is not ready against the corresponding backend behavior.

nodes.name: test_profiles_are_isolated_and_context_does_not_leak
nodes.summary: Verifies profiles are isolated and context does not leak against the corresponding backend behavior.

nodes.name: test_runtime_cannot_forge_profile_or_publish
nodes.summary: Verifies runtime cannot forge profile or publish against the corresponding backend behavior.

nodes.name: test_banks_are_complete_and_private
nodes.summary: Verifies banks are complete and private against the corresponding backend behavior.

nodes.name: test_answer_foreign_keys_and_attempt_ownership
nodes.summary: Verifies answer foreign keys and attempt ownership against the corresponding backend behavior.

nodes.name: test_published_content_is_immutable
nodes.summary: Verifies published content is immutable against the corresponding backend behavior.

nodes.name: test_invalid_publication_is_rejected
nodes.summary: Verifies invalid publication is rejected against the corresponding backend behavior.

nodes.name: test_context_is_required_for_writes
nodes.summary: Verifies context is required for writes against the corresponding backend behavior.

nodes.name: test_import_cannot_attach_another_students_attempt
nodes.summary: Verifies import cannot attach another students attempt against the corresponding backend behavior.

nodes.name: test_completed_attempt_cannot_receive_answers
nodes.summary: Verifies completed attempt cannot receive answers against the corresponding backend behavior.

nodes.name: test_profile_api.py
nodes.summary: Tests real Supabase registration and bearer authentication against profile CRUD, idempotency, rejected client ownership fields and optimistic revision conflicts.

nodes.name: test_real_auth_profile_contract
nodes.summary: Verifies real auth profile contract against the corresponding backend behavior.

nodes.name: test_health.py
nodes.summary: Tests database-independent liveness, readiness failure/recovery, pool closure, explicit CORS, bounded settings and secret redaction.

nodes.name: test_live_does_not_need_database
nodes.summary: Verifies live does not need database against the corresponding backend behavior.

nodes.name: test_readiness_recovers_and_closes_pool
nodes.summary: Verifies readiness recovers and closes pool against the corresponding backend behavior.

nodes.name: test_cors_is_explicit
nodes.summary: Verifies cors is explicit against the corresponding backend behavior.

nodes.name: test_pool_size_is_bounded
nodes.summary: Verifies pool size is bounded against the corresponding backend behavior.

nodes.name: test_secret_is_redacted
nodes.summary: Verifies secret is redacted against the corresponding backend behavior.

nodes.name: FakeDatabase
nodes.summary: Provides controllable readiness failure and closure state for isolated health tests.

nodes.name: configure_auth.py
nodes.summary: Adds missing local Auth and API settings to ignored backend/frontend environment files after verifying the dedicated Supabase target.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Appends missing local Auth configuration without overwriting another Auth environment or printing keys.

nodes.name: local_stack.py
nodes.summary: Reads Supabase CLI status privately and rejects unexpected project, database host/port/name or Auth endpoint before local tooling and tests connect.

nodes.name: local_status
nodes.summary: Obtains local Supabase status and validates the dedicated project, PostgreSQL connection target and Auth URL before returning it.

nodes.name: setup_local.py
nodes.summary: Provisions a random or existing runtime-role password only on the dedicated local database and writes a missing ignored backend configuration.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Verifies the dedicated local schema, safely sets the runtime-role password and creates missing ignored connection settings.

nodes.name: Database.__init__
nodes.summary: Configures a bounded lazy-open Psycopg connection pool with acquisition, connection, query and lock timeouts.

nodes.name: Database.check_role
nodes.summary: Rejects SQL connections unless app_runtime is non-superuser, cannot bypass RLS and is not a member of app_owner.

nodes.name: Database.check_ready
nodes.summary: Acquires a connection, checks the restricted role and requires the expected schema version.

nodes.name: Database.transaction_for
nodes.summary: Requires a UUID and sets app.user_id locally within a database transaction so identity does not leak across pool reuse.
